description: NaTi₂BiO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. Ti is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.99 Å. Bi is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and four longer (2.38 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Bi atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaTi₂Bi tetrahedra.
